How the rules are ranked

Each rule is a check on a handicap. On the training seasons (2023/24, 2024/25) the bets placed with no rules were split into those that meet the rule and those that break it. Importance is how clearly the first group returned more per bet (a t statistic: 2+ is clear evidence, 1 to 2 moderate).

Tiers: must have = importance 2+ and the bets breaking it lost money; recommended = importance 1+ and the same; nice to have = any positive importance; off = no help. Move a rule to another tier to change what each setting asks; your tiers are saved in this browser.

The default setting was chosen on 2025/26; later seasons are a test. Ranked on 2026-11-07 04:19 UTC.

How the picks are made

For every match we look at each whole, half and quarter handicap and the best price across bookmakers.

The fair chance of each outcome comes from the bookmakers except Pinnacle (its odds still count as a price you can take). A handicap has value when the best price pays more than that chance is worth. At most one bet per match.

A quarter handicap (e.g. −0.75) puts half the stake on each neighbouring line (−0.5 and −1), so it can end half won or half lost.

Prices move: check the price before betting and never take less than the fair odds shown.

Bayesian value

The market's expected goals are the prior; per team an attack and a defence correction and a global home / away bias are updated after every match (Kalman filter). Tuned on 2023/24, 2024/25: team layer sd 0.0. A bet is the handicap with the highest value at the best price, between the threshold and 10%, on lines quoted by at least 3 bookmakers besides Pinnacle. Chosen on 2026-11-07 04:19 UTC. Each line type is checked on its own: whole and half lines +7.1% ± 4.6% on 370 bets (passes); quarter lines +1.6% ± 4.7% on 343 bets (does not pass). A match's bet is its best option among the types that pass.

Profit model

Built to maximise profit with at most one bet per match. Its seasons: 2023/24 rules, 2024/25 tuning, 2025/26 test, 2026/27 real. The model (logistic, on logit_crowd, logit_bayes, log_odds, home, quarter, log_books, crowd_se) predicts walk-forward, each month from a model trained on earlier matches only. Setting: value 1% to 20%, at least 1 bookmaker besides Pinnacle, all lines; 2024/25: 4,324 bets, +4.3% per bet. Test 2025/26: +3.3% ± 1.3% per bet over 4,111 bets. Each line type is checked on its own: whole and half lines +2.6% ± 1.6% on 3,124 bets (passes); quarter lines +2.9% ± 1.5% on 3,115 bets (passes). A match's bet is its best option among the types that pass. Run profit-20261107-0419, trained on 15,614 matches up to 2026-11-06 20:45 UTC; retrained after 200 new finished matches (107 now).
